## Computational Materials Scientist – Theoretical Physicist

Henry is a computational materials scientist and theoretical physicist currently working as a Severo Ochoa postdoctoral researcher in the [Modelling and Simulation in Life and Materials Sciences (MSLMS) group](https://www.bcamath.org/en/research/areas/m3a/mslms) at the Basque Center for Applied Mathematics (BCAM), Spain.

He has been awarded a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Postdoctoral Fellowship (MSCA-PF-2025) for **MULTI-SMARTSEI**, a project focused on the multiscale modelling of solid-electrolyte interphases in next-generation lithium batteries. The project brings together complementary expertise from three research groups: Prof. Elena Akhmatskaya’s [MSLMS group](https://www.bcamath.org/en/research/areas/m3a/mslms) at BCAM; Prof. Perla B. Balbuena’s [Balbuena Lab](https://balbuena-research.com/) at Texas A&M University; and Prof. Javier Carrasco’s [Modelling and Computational Simulation group](https://cicenergigune.com/en/modelling-and-computational-simulation) at CIC energiGUNE.

His research centres on the atomistic and multiscale modelling of materials for energy storage, with particular emphasis on solid-state and lithium-based batteries. He combines first-principles calculations, molecular dynamics, and data-driven analysis to investigate ion transport, interfacial phenomena, and structure–property relationships in complex materials systems.
